copper.name: Bright copper wire (scrap)
copper.basis: Indicative scrap buying rate, subject to grading. A retail chocolate price versus a scrap buying price, for perspective; not a copper retail or exchange quote.

lithium.name: Lithium
lithium.basis: Published GBP quote for 15 September 2026. The provider tracks lithium carbonate, not pure lithium metal. This is a commodity reference, not a retail purchase price. The earlier £15.31 quote was dated 14 September.

dairy_milk.name: Cadbury Dairy Milk 110g
dairy_milk.basis: Tesco's public standard price was £1.85 for a 110g bar, with a displayed unit price of £16.82/kg. The separate £1.50 Clubcard offer is excluded. Online prices may vary by location. It was checked within 48 hours of the snapshot cut-off; current prices may differ.

lobster.name: Whole cooked lobster
lobster.basis: Waitrose's displayed unit price for its frozen Canadian whole cooked lobster, 350g, on offer at £9.35 (was £12.50). Includes shell; not the price of edible meat alone. We use the retailer's stated £26.72/kg, which differs slightly from dividing the rounded pack price by its weight. Delivery is excluded. This offer was checked within 48 hours of the snapshot cut-off; current prices may differ.
